name: MonarchAiContextChips
title: AiContextChips
wrapsNative: androidx.compose.foundation.layout.FlowRow of androidx.compose.material3.AssistChip for removable items; android.icu.text.CompactDecimalFormat for counts
summary: What the AI will see with the next prompt, as chips with a kind, a name, a token count with a weight mark, and a total; removable chips remove on tap.
whenToUse: Above or inside an AI composer, to show the files, selections, pages, records, apps and people attached to the next prompt and let the person remove them.
whenNotToUse: For tags on user data use MonarchTag. For a divider that marks where the context was reset in a thread use MonarchAiContextDivider.
api: @Composable fun MonarchAiContextChips(items: List<MonarchAiContextItem>, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, budget: Int? = null, showTotal: Boolean? = null, enabled: Boolean = true, emptyText: String? = null, onRemove: ((String) -> Unit)? = null, kindIcon: (@Composable (MonarchAiContextKind) -> Unit)? = null, removeIcon: (@Composable () -> Unit)? = null, labels: MonarchAiContextChipsLabels = MonarchAiContextChipsLabels())
class MonarchAiContextItem(id: String, kind: MonarchAiContextKind, label: String, tokens: Int? = null, description: String? = null, removable: Boolean = true)
enum class MonarchAiContextKind { File, Selection, Page, Record, App, Person }
enum class MonarchAiContextWeight { Light, Medium, Heavy; companion object { fun of(tokens: Int, reference: Int): MonarchAiContextWeight } }

class MonarchAiContextChipsLabels(label: String? = null, kind: ((MonarchAiContextKind) -> String)? = null, tokens: ((formatted: String, count: Int) -> String)? = null, total: ((formatted: String, count: Int) -> String)? = null, remove: ((label: String) -> String)? = null, removed: ((label: String) -> String)? = null)

options.name: items
options.description: What the AI will see, in the order it was added.

options.name: budget
options.description: Tokens the context may use. When set, each weight is the item's share of the budget instead of the total.

options.name: showTotal
options.description: Whether the total is shown after the chips. By default when any item has a token count; never with no items.

options.name: enabled
options.description: Whether chips can be removed. Disabled chips use the muted fill and disabled text.

options.name: emptyText
options.description: Shown when items is empty, in the subtle text color. Without it nothing is shown.

options.name: onRemove
options.description: Called with the id of the item to remove; take it out of items. No chip is removable without it; items with removable = false never are.

options.name: kindIcon
options.description: An icon for the kind at the start of each chip, tinted with the AI strong color and hidden from TalkBack. Monarch bundles no icons.

options.name: removeIcon
options.description: A decorative close mark at the end of removable chips. Without it the chip is still removed by a tap.

options.name: labels
options.description: Replacements for the group name, kind names, count and total texts, the remove action and the removal announcement.

states.name: weight
states.description: Light, medium or heavy fill one, two or three bars of the mark in the AI strong color; heavy also draws the count in the default text color.

states.name: removable
states.description: An AssistChip: a tap, or Delete and Backspace on a hardware keyboard, removes it.

states.name: not removable
states.description: The same look without an action or a touch target.

states.name: empty
states.description: Shows emptyText in the subtle text color, or nothing.

states.name: disabled
states.description: Muted fill, subtle border, disabled text and bars; the chips do not remove.

appearance: Fully rounded chips in the AI subtle fill with the AI border; the kind icon and the filled bars in the AI strong role, empty bars in the default border role, counts and the total in the muted text role. Disabled chips use the muted background, subtle border and disabled text roles. All are theme roles, so light, dark and both high-contrast themes follow.
platformNotes: Same kinds, weights, compact counts and strings as the web and iOS. The parity map names InputChip; removable chips are AssistChips instead, as in MonarchTag, because InputChip is selectable and TalkBack would read every chip as a checkbox. The whole chip is the remove action, as Material 3 input chips are, instead of a separate remove button: TalkBack reads the chip as a button with the action "Remove … from context". The web shows the description as a tooltip; on Android it is read by TalkBack after the chip. The web and iOS move focus to the next chip after a removal; on Android focus is left to the system. The kind icons are a slot because Monarch bundles no icons; the kind is always read as text. Compact counts use android.icu.text.CompactDecimalFormat in the configuration's locale; iOS takes a locale parameter.
accessibility: The chips are a traversal group named "Context".
Each chip is one element read as kind, name and count, "File: contract.pdf, 1.2K tokens", then the description; the full name is read even when it is cut on screen.
A removable chip is a button whose action is named "Remove contract.pdf from context", with a 48dp touch target reserved in the layout.
After a removal, "contract.pdf removed from context" is announced through a polite live region.
The weight is shown by the number of filled bars and by the count, not by color alone; the kind and remove icons are hidden.
edgeCases: A long name is cut in the middle at 192dp, scaled with the font size.
Chips wrap onto new rows; the total follows the last chip.
Exactly one token reads "1 token"; negative counts are shown as 0; items without a count have no mark and do not add to the total.
Removal announcements happen when the chip is tapped, even if the app keeps the item.

            id = {{items.0.id}},
            kind = MonarchAiContextKind.{{items.0.kind|pascal}},
            label = {{items.0.label}},
            tokens = {{items.0.tokens}},
            removable = {{items.0.removable}},
        ),
        MonarchAiContextItem(

            id = "file",

examples.title: Against a budget
examples.code:
MonarchAiContextChips(
    items = listOf(
        MonarchAiContextItem("ticket", MonarchAiContextKind.Record, "Ticket 4821", tokens = 90_000),
        MonarchAiContextItem("page", MonarchAiContextKind.Page, "Q3 planning", tokens = 2100, removable = false),
    ),
    budget = 128_000,
)
